question: In round 5's 8x12 interleaved A/B of the glass refract-skip candidate against the round-4 binary, what gpu_min did the candidate measure?

The glass refract-skip candidate measured gpu_ms_best = 44.757 ms in that 8x12 interleaved A/B at 512x512/64spp seed 1.

How I know: the archived A/B tool output (history message #78) printed "_ab_cand.txt render_min=45.025 render_mean=46.563 gpu_min=44.757" for the candidate, with the round-4 base at render_min=43.315 / gpu_min=43.026 (the paired run list shows the 45.025/44.757 pair from the same round).
